QUOTE: When `hasSearch` is true, it renders `<NavigationSearch {...searchProps} ... ref={ref} />` (lines 128–136). The ref is forwarded as is
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says NavigationHeader forwards its ref to NavigationSearch only when `hasSearch` is true. It adds that other callers pass a ref but to their scroll view, not to a search field. It never says outright that the ref attaches to nothing when `hasSearch` is false, but the conditional rendering and the forwarding together carry the item's substance.
